meta.comment: Phase-3 Comprehension data. Placeholder flat ladder — Phase 10 Balancing retunes.

definitions.name: Shallow
definitions.description: A surface understanding of the Dao — deep truths slip through the mind like water through fingers.

definitions.name: Limited
definitions.description: A narrow understanding that grasps only the most straightforward teachings.

definitions.name: Standard
definitions.description: An ordinary comprehension of the Dao — enough to follow the common path.

definitions.name: Insightful
definitions.description: A perceptive mind that pierces beneath the surface of every teaching.

definitions.name: Penetrating
definitions.description: An understanding that cuts to the heart of any technique or principle.

definitions.name: Enlightened
definitions.description: A profound comprehension — the mysteries of the Dao unfold almost unbidden.

definitions.name: Dao Heart
definitions.description: An unshakeable understanding of the Way — principles and techniques resolve themselves before it.
